parallels.note: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

translations.web: “Yahweh kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up.
translations.bsb: The LORD brings death and gives life; He brings down to Sheol and raises up.
translations.kjv: The LORD killeth, and maketh alive: he bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up.
translations.asv: Jehovah killeth, and maketh alive: He bringeth down to Sheol, and bringeth up.
